format: C++/Objective-C++ (Objective-C bindings for Metal Performance Shaders - MPS)
description: This file contains implementations of reduction operations for PyTorch tensors on the Apple MPS backend, including functions for sum, max, min, mean, variance, standard deviation, median, trace, and argmax/argmin using Metal Performance Shaders. It defines helper functions for setting shapes and axes, manages cached computation graphs, and exposes several operator implementations for reduction-related functionalities.

classes.name: CachedGraph
classes.description: A base class for cached MPS graph representations, specific implementations like MPSUnaryCachedGraph and MPSBinaryCachedGraph are used for different operation types.

methods.name: set_apparent_shapes
methods.description: Sets the apparent input and output shapes for reduction operations based on input shape and axes.

methods.name: set_axes
methods.description: Configures axes for reduction, either default or specified.

methods.name: set_axes_and_shapes
methods.description: Prepares axes and shapes for reduction operation.

methods.name: reduction_out_mps
methods.description: Performs reduction operations using an MPS graph for a given tensor and reduction type.

methods.name: impl_func_norm_mps
methods.description: Implementation for tensor norm calculations (e.g., p-norm, cdist) using MPS on Apple devices.

methods.name: std_var_common_impl_mps
methods.description: Computes variance or standard deviation for a tensor using MPS, handling different reduction dims and keepdim options.

methods.name: median_common_mps
methods.description: Computes median (including nan median) of a tensor via MPS.

methods.name: min_max_mps_impl
methods.description: Calculates min/max for a tensor, returning the scalar value.

methods.name: min_max_out_mps
methods.description: Calculates min/max along a specific dimension, with support for keepdim.

methods.name: argmax_argmin_out_mps
methods.description: Computes argmax or argmin along a specified dimension, returning indices.

methods.name: min_max_mps_impl
methods.description: Helper for min/max tensor reduction to scalar.

methods.name: max_mps
methods.description: Computes the maximum value in the tensor using MPS.

methods.name: min_mps
methods.description: Computes the minimum value in the tensor using MPS.
